reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown reconcile the totals by reading Paul's 23,000 as those killed by the plague alone, while Moses' 24,000 adds those the judges executed.

sides.snippet: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
sides.verseText: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

sides.snippet: in one day twenty-three thousand fell
sides.verseText: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
